scope: Selected shared/hero calculations reviewed during broader mechanics inventory

findings.subject: Shared tenacity
findings.finding: Returns 1/(1 + captured native Tenacity). Displayed-stat conversion, capture source and final effect application remain unverified.

findings.subject: Shared cooldown
findings.finding: Returns 1/(1 + captured CooldownReduction). Native attribute units/bindings remain unresolved; this does not independently verify catalog conversion.

findings.subject: Ultimate cooldown
findings.finding: Adds captured CooldownReduction and UltimateAbilityHaste before reciprocal conversion. Capture modes/bindings still require verification.

findings.subject: Basic attack timing
findings.finding: Captures BasicAttackTime and AttackSpeed, then calls native CalculateAttackCooldown. The wrapper does not expose attack-speed cap, native clamps or animation timing.

findings.subject: Kira Dusk
findings.finding: Returns BaseDamage + SetByCaller.BonusDamage * (DamagePerStack + captured AttackDamage * PPScaling). Scalar fields use effect level; capture enum 2 and scalar default bindings remain unresolved. Caller meaning and timing must be traced before integration.

findings.subject: Belica ultimate mana component
findings.finding: Returns (captured MaxMana - captured Mana) * rank-dependent NeuralDisruptor_ManaToDamage curve. Target/source capture semantics and complete effect composition remain unresolved.
